limitations: Observation date is 2026-10-31. Publication and historical event metadata are distinct from decision windows. Window kind categorizes actual deadlines, announced targets, proposed tests or unknowns. Geneva June21–22 2027 is the user's planning premise, not independently verified here.

Three refinements, no extra candidate. Taiwan now has operative programme evidence; it is the most concrete pilot-design lead in this set, but not selected by or agreed with an institution. The 2027 application/contract drafting date is still unknown.

Null coverage means unmeasured, never zero. Context ratios have matched units but are not implementation-feasibility scores or safety-impact scores. No defensible national/global supply-chain denominator was obtained.

Canada GDP ratio compares a multi-stage ceiling with one forecast year; it is scale context only, with inferred CAD currency for the PM figure. Target round share is conditional arithmetic, not government ownership or actual dependency.

Taiwan's 2027 programme/agency budget ratio is a genuine planned budget composition fraction, not compute-only spending. Draft figures and performance targets are not enacted, paid or achieved. Heterogeneous GPUs cannot be pooled as equivalent performance.
All scenario roles are evidence-constrained simulations, not quotations, contacts or consent. Every safety appendix, evaluation pilot, success formula and research checkpoint is proposed.

Signed rights, observed compliance, corrected test failures and real-world risk reduction are separate outcomes. Report numerator/denominator counts, missing data and uncertainty. Zero eligible observations makes a ratio undefined; do not award success for no incidents.

Anthropic private lender allocations, new-credit dates, economic necessity, company alternatives and priced replacement funding remain unresolved. No lender nationality tally, public bank-control inference or withholding of compliant committed draws is authorized by this analysis.

Keyword absence is not evidence of absent safeguards. Existing Taiwan performance/security duties and Cohere's CAISI undertaking require a marginal-addition review; Anthropic requires full covenant review before claiming novelty.

Retrieval did not contact parties, use git, install software, start background work or write raw sources. Only finance.md and finance.json were authored. Initial pypdf/pdftotext unavailability was worked around with preinstalled PDFKit.
